key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:26786
name: cull_and_transform_face_points
description: Rejects a face record whose cross-product tests exceed its bounding size, then scales three coordinates by a computed shift and multiplies them through a 3x3 matrix before storing them. A flag bit makes it recurse into a helper first.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:267D2
name: cull_and_store_projected_face
description: Normalizes three coordinates by a computed shift, returns early when its cross-product tests fail, and otherwise multiplies the vertex data through a 3x3 matrix. The result is kept only if it is nearer than the stored best value.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:26896
name: store_nearer_transformed_point
description: Transforms a point through a 3x3 matrix after a shift adjustment and calls a helper to finish. It saves the coordinates and depth into the output record only when the depth is smaller than the value already stored.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:2692E
name: transform_vertices_keep_nearest
description: Multiplies two sets of three vertex coordinates by a 3x3 matrix into an output buffer and calls a helper. It keeps the record only when its depth is smaller than the current best.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:26A58
name: interpret_command_stream_entries
description: Walks a zero-terminated stream of command bytes. Each entry either passes or fails a bit-mask test against a field of the current record; passing entries look up a vertex set, apply optional sign flips through a table, and call helpers.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:26A92
name: process_command_stream_after_header
description: Reads a zero-terminated byte stream after a header, applying the same bit-mask test to each entry. Entries that pass transform a referenced vertex set through a lookup table and are handed to helper routines.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:26A9C
name: process_masked_command_stream
description: Begins with a bit test on a register value, then loops over command bytes. Entries with the sign bit set transform a referenced vertex set through a table and call helpers; other entries call helpers with a masked counter.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:26AD2
name: stub_return_only
description: The routine consists of a single return, so it performs no work and has no observable behaviour.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:26AD4
name: run_command_stream_loop
description: Runs a zero-terminated command-byte loop that first handles a masked counter, then walks each entry. Entries whose bit test fails are skipped, and the rest transform a vertex set and call helpers.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:26AFC
name: walk_command_stream_entries
description: Reads command bytes until a zero terminator. Entries with the sign bit set are dispatched to helpers according to a second bit, while other entries transform a vertex set through a lookup table and call helper routines.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:26B22
name: interpret_vertex_command_stream
description: Loops over command bytes until a zero terminator. Entries with the sign bit set transform a referenced vertex set through a lookup table, pass it to a helper, and call further helpers; other entries are handled by a masked-counter path.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:26BCE
name: record_undecompiled_routine_13
description: Pseudo-code could not be produced for this 13-instruction routine. The only evidence is that one routine calls it and it calls one other routine, so its behaviour is not recovered.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:26BF4
name: record_undecompiled_routine_41
description: Pseudo-code could not be produced for this 41-instruction routine. The recovered evidence is that two routines call it and it calls four others, so its behaviour is not recovered.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:26C76
name: record_undecompiled_routine_6
description: Pseudo-code could not be produced for this 6-instruction routine. The recovered evidence is that one routine calls it and it calls three others, so its behaviour is not recovered.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:26C8A
name: record_undecompiled_routine_7
description: Pseudo-code could not be produced for this 7-instruction routine. The recovered evidence is that one routine calls it and it calls three others, so its behaviour is not recovered.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:26CA0
name: match_entries_within_bounds
description: Walks a zero-terminated byte list, passing each value to a helper and comparing the result with two bounds. Values inside the bounds cause three words to be stored into a record, and the routine skips to the end of the list when it finishes.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:26CC8
name: select_entries_by_signed_bounds
description: Iterates a zero-terminated list while a signed value stays within bounds, calling a helper for each item. Items that fall in range store three words into a record.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:26CE0
name: store_entry_within_range
description: Scans a zero-terminated list, calling a helper per item. When an item's value fits between the two bounds it stores three words into a record, then skips to the end of the list.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:26D02
name: store_entries_up_to_limit
description: Walks a zero-terminated list, calling a helper per item. Whenever an item's value is at or below a bound it stores three words into a record, and the loop stops once the value goes negative.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:26D18
name: divide_projected_coordinate
description: Looks up two table entries from a record, computes a weighted sum of three coordinates minus a reference point, and divides it by a weighted scale value. It returns quotient and remainder packed together, or a saturated maximum when the divisor is zero.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:26D4E
name: divide_relative_coordinate_packed
description: Computes a weighted sum of three coordinates relative to a reference point, then divides it by a weighted scale value. It returns quotient and remainder packed together, or a saturated maximum when the divisor is zero.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:26D92
name: divide_shifted_coordinate_sum
description: Shifts three coordinates left when a flag is clear, computes a weighted sum relative to a reference point, and divides it by a weighted scale value. It returns quotient and remainder packed together, or a saturated maximum for a zero divisor.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:26DD0
name: compute_bitwise_xor
description: XORs a register with the upper word of its input, then returns that value packed with its sign extension and XORed with a mask of every bit except the sign bit.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:26DDE
name: test_segment_sphere_intersection
description: Stores six transform values, then rejects the candidate unless its components pass sign-normalized bounds checks. It forms squared terms against a radius field, solves the resulting quadratic with an iterative root step, and saves the distance as the nearest hit when it is closer.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:26E3E
name: solve_sphere_hit_distance
description: Builds fixed-point coefficients from stored values and a radius-like field, then runs an iterative root step. The resulting distance and fraction are saved into the hit record.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:26E78
name: record_sphere_hit_candidate
description: Repeats a larger set of sign-normalized fixed-point products and squared terms to decide whether a sphere intersection exists. When the computed distance is nearer than the stored best, it saves the hit distance and transform values.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:26FFA
name: store_nearer_hit_candidate
description: Compares a scaled value against the stored best distance. When it is nearer, saves the distance, the fixed-point result and status flags into the hit record.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:2700E
name: store_hit_candidate_scaled
description: Shifts a value by a stored exponent and, when it beats the current best distance, saves the scaled result with status flags and a copy of the transform values into the hit record.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:27034
name: store_hit_record_unconditionally
description: Writes a distance, a computed exponent and the transform values into the hit record, and sets its status flags without comparing against the stored best.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:2708E
name: copy_block_from_pointer
description: Waits for a busy flag to clear, then copies eight values from the source pointer into a destination block and clears a status byte.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:270AC
name: copy_globals_after_call
description: Calls one routine, then copies eight longwords from global memory into a record, sets one word from a global and another word to a constant, and sets a status byte to a non-zero value.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:270B2
name: copy_block_from_globals
description: Copies eight longwords from global memory into a destination record, sets one word to a global value and another word to a constant, and sets a status byte to a non-zero value.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:270D2
name: wait_for_flags_clear
description: Busy-waits until a record flag and a global variable both become zero, then returns.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:270E2
name: copy_large_block
description: Copies 800 blocks of ten words from a source pointer to a destination pointer, then returns two data registers combined into one value.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:2710C
name: copy_strided_table_blocks
description: Loops 32 times copying ten-word blocks at fixed offsets between two tables, and copies single words at three further fixed offsets on each pass. It then returns two data registers combined into one value.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:27160
name: save_data_registers_to_record
description: Saves the input data registers into a record block and sets a status byte to a non-zero value.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:2716E
name: clear_status_around_call
description: Clears a status byte, waits for a busy flag to clear, writes a fixed word and a zero byte into a record, calls one routine, and waits for the busy flag again.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:27178
name: store_word_into_two_fields
description: Stores the low word of the first data register into two record fields.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:27182
name: swap_buffer_pointers
description: Copies eight longwords within a record, then swaps two global buffer pointers. The copper list pointer register is also touched.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:271CA
name: copy_first_pointer_to_slot
description: Copies the first global pointer variable into a second global slot and returns.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:271D6
name: copy_second_pointer_to_slot
description: Copies the second global pointer variable into a third global slot and returns.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:271E2
name: infinite_loop_halt
description: Loops forever without any data operations or hardware access, so control never returns.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:271FC
name: wait_and_set_flag_one
description: Loops until a global counter becomes non-positive, then sets that counter to one.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:2720E
name: wait_and_set_flag_two
description: Loops until a global counter becomes non-positive, then sets that counter to two.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:27320
name: fetch_pending_table_entry
description: Reads a pending byte from the record. A positive value clears the byte and returns an entry from one of two tables chosen by flag bytes; a negative value clears it and returns the stored byte with its sign.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:27348
name: take_pending_byte_value
description: Clears a flag byte in the record and returns the byte stored beside it.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:27352
name: queue_pending_byte_value
description: Stores the low byte of its input in the record and sets the flag byte to non-zero.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:2735E
name: poll_pending_byte_entry
description: Checks a counter byte. A negative value returns the stored byte, zero returns zero, and a positive value clears the flag and returns an entry from one of two tables.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:2736C
name: clear_pending_counter_byte
description: Clears a counter byte in the record.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:27422
name: setup_graphics_interrupts
description: Clears a block of 32 longwords in the record, opens graphics.library through the exec base, and calls helper and library routines. It then writes display, DMA, copper and colour register values, including interrupt enable writes.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:27584
name: wait_and_call_handlers
description: Waits for a busy flag in the record to clear, sets a global value, then calls a library vector and a function pointer taken from record data.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:275B8
name: invoke_interrupt_handler
description: Calls a function pointer from a global table, sets global variables, and executes another routine through a library vector.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:275EE
name: remove_graphics_interrupts
description: Writes custom register values, calls library vectors to disable DMA and interrupts, removes an interrupt server, and then closes the library through the close-library stub.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:27666
name: copy_color_palette_when_ready
description: Waits until a global counter reaches a threshold, then copies eight words from a global block into palette registers.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:276AA
name: poll_input_and_update_frame
description: Updates counters and timers each frame, copies a block of values into palette and blitter registers, and calls helpers depending on flag bytes. The facts also show reads of joystick, mouse-button and fire-button registers.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:277BE
name: step_timed_sequence_counter
description: Decrements a countdown. While it stays non-zero it writes a shifted flag word and an advanced position value to hardware registers; when it reaches zero it clears a state byte instead.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:277F0
name: advance_blitter_position_step
description: Halves a flag word in the record, advances a stored position by a fixed step, and writes the position and a fixed value to blitter registers.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:27826
name: clear_busy_flag_and_enable
description: Clears the busy flag word in the record and writes an interrupt-enable value to the interrupt enable register.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:27864
name: open_input_device
description: Stores two values returned by helper routines. If the second is non-zero it sets its message fields and calls exec library routines to open input.device.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:278BC
name: close_input_device
description: If a stored message object exists, sets its fields and calls exec library routines to close input.device, then releases the port through helper routines.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:2790A
name: update_flag_table_entry
description: Checks a record type byte. For type one it sets a table flag from a high bit of the record, compares a status byte, and stores the new state; other types return immediately.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:2794A
name: clear_record_small_fields
description: Zeroes three bytes and one word stored at small negative offsets from the record pointer.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:279BE
name: allocate_message_port
description: Allocates a message port through exec library calls and initializes its signal, type, name and list fields. It returns the new structure, or zero when allocation fails.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:27A42
name: free_message_port
description: Frees a message port when it is non-null. If the port is attached it is removed first, two fields are marked released, and library routines free its signal and memory.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:27A86
name: reset_coordinate_pair_defaults
description: Sets a pair of record words to zero and to 512 respectively.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:27A8C
name: store_coordinate_pair
description: Stores two input words into a pair of record fields.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:27A96
name: read_coordinate_pair
description: Returns a pair of record words at fixed offsets packed into one 32-bit result.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:27AA4
name: read_low_two_bits
description: Returns the low two bits of a record byte.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:27AAE
name: update_cursor_position
description: Adds input deltas to a stored x and y position, clamps them to the 0-319 and 0-199 screen bounds, and writes a palette-style value to a register. When a button flag is set it tests the position against a table of rectangles and stores the matching value and status flags.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:27BDE
name: process_joystick_input
description: Reduces two velocity words toward zero by 300 per step, then adds or subtracts 700 for each directional flag, saturating at the 16-bit limits. It stores both velocities and a status word back into the record, and the facts show reads of the joystick port registers.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:27CEE
name: set_status_word_ones
description: Sets a record word to all ones.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:27D98
name: append_global_record_list
description: Finds the end of a five-word record list in the record, then copies five-word entries from a global list into it until a negative terminator. Each copied entry ends with a -1 marker.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:27DA2
name: copy_table_from_input_pointer
description: Locates the end of a five-word record list in the record and copies five-word entries from the input pointer into it, terminating the sequence with -1.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:27DC6
name: shift_records_in_buffer
description: Searches the five-word record list for an entry matching the input value, then shifts the following records back over it, keeping the negative terminator.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:27DEC
name: append_clamped_record
description: Appends a five-word record to the end of the list, storing two input coordinates offset by a third input, and clamps the start values to be non-negative.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:27DF2
name: append_record_to_buffer
description: Appends a five-word record to the end of the list. It stores sums of input values and clamps the start values at zero.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:27E30
name: initialize_coordinate_table
description: Stores the input value and three further values offset by 8000, 16000 and 24000 as split words in a record, and sets fixed constant words at eight pairs of offsets.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:27F5C
name: run_timed_main_loop
description: Resets a block of state fields, then enters an endless loop. Each pass advances a 64-bit timer, runs a step routine when the timer passes a threshold, and calls a series of table routines, with a branch chosen by a status flag.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:27FC6
name: run_timed_sequence_with_keys
description: Runs a timed sequence of routine calls that counts a step timer down from a fixed start toward a fixed limit. It then polls a key byte and leaves the sequence when one of several character keys is pressed.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:28056
name: run_timed_key_wait_loop
description: Runs a timed loop that advances a timer and polls a key byte. It exits when a key from one to five is pressed or the timer passes a limit, after which it clears a flag and calls the next routines.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:28104
name: run_main_simulation_loop
description: Initializes pointer globals and calls about twenty setup routines, then loops forever. Each pass advances a 64-bit counter, calls table routines, and when a digit key or a counter limit is reached it waits and calls the next routines.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:284AC
name: format_signed_decimal_string
description: Writes a leading minus sign for negative input, then converts the value into decimal digit characters by repeated subtraction of powers of ten and terminates the string.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:2852C
name: convert_integer_to_decimal_string
description: Converts a 32-bit value into decimal digit characters by repeatedly subtracting powers of ten, then writes a terminator.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:28610
name: store_fields_and_call_helper
description: Stores a shifted word and a byte into record fields, calls one routine, then derives a doubled index from a stored byte and records it in a table entry.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:2862A
name: convert_integer_to_hex_string
description: Converts a 32-bit value into eight hexadecimal characters by rotating it four bits at a time, mapping each nibble to a digit or letter, and writing a zero terminator.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:2864C
name: read_text_line_with_editing
description: Reads characters through a helper until carriage return. It handles backspace and delete, and appends letters, digits, spaces and some punctuation to a buffer while the remaining length allows.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:286D2
name: read_text_line_simple
description: Reads characters until carriage return, handling delete and backspace, and appends letters, digits and some punctuation to a buffer while space remains.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:286EC
name: call_helper_then_return
description: Calls one helper routine and returns, with no other effect.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:286FC
name: parse_signed_decimal_integer
description: Parses a signed decimal integer from a character string, handling a leading minus sign by recursing into a helper for the magnitude.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:2870C
name: skip_decimal_digits
description: Advances the input pointer past consecutive decimal digit characters and returns.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:28734
name: call_helper_discard_result
description: Calls one helper routine and returns without using its result.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:28758
name: compute_cross_product
description: Stores three components into the record, then forms cross-product style combinations of the stored and input components and writes three result values. A helper is called for magnitudes.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:2881C
name: return_constant_two
description: Returns the constant two.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:28824
name: return_constant_three
description: Returns the constant three.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:2882C
name: return_constant_four
description: Returns the constant four.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:28834
name: return_constant_five
description: Returns the constant five.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:28850
name: classify_value_into_band
description: Compares an input value against descending thresholds and returns a band number, together with a boundary value, packed into one result.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:28880
name: update_object_motion_with_damping
description: Adds a scaled velocity to three position words, then damps each axis by shifting when its value is large enough. It calls helpers for the adjustment, decrements a counter byte, and resets it when it underflows.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:28998
name: damp_velocity_axis_pair
description: Applies damping to position words for one axis when a velocity word exceeds a threshold. It calls a helper for the amount and decrements a counter byte, resetting it when it underflows.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:2899E
name: damp_velocity_axis_triplet
description: Applies threshold-based damping to three position words for one axis of motion, calling a helper for the amount and decrementing a counter byte that resets on underflow.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:28A68
name: damp_axis_group_primary
description: Applies threshold-based damping to position words for one axis group. It calls a helper for the amount, shifts the words, and decrements a counter byte that resets on underflow.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:28B34
name: damp_single_axis_pair
description: Applies damping to a pair of position words for one axis when a velocity word exceeds a threshold, decrementing a counter byte that resets on underflow.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:28B3A
name: damp_axis_group_secondary
description: Applies threshold-based damping to position words along a second axis group, calling a helper for the amount and decrementing a counter byte that resets on underflow.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:28C04
name: damp_axis_group_tertiary
description: Applies threshold-based damping to position words along a third axis group, calling a helper for the amount and decrementing a counter byte that resets on underflow.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:28CCE
name: stub_return_only
description: The routine consists of a single return, so it performs no work and has no observable behaviour.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:28CD2
name: damp_axis_group_quaternary
description: Applies threshold-based damping to position words along a fourth axis group, calling a helper for the amount and decrementing a counter byte that resets on underflow.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:28D9A
name: stub_return_only
description: The routine consists of a single return, so it performs no work and has no observable behaviour.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:28D9C
name: shift_and_store_offsets
description: Reads two short values from the structure, shifts one right by three bits and the other right by two with its sign negated, and stores the results at two other offsets in the same structure.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:28DB2
name: compute_dot_product_clamped
description: Computes two dot products of vector components held in the structure and stores them at fixed offsets. If a third dot product is negative, it clamps the first two results to positive or negative 16384 according to their sign.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:28E2E
name: compute_dot_product_inverted
description: Computes two dot products of vector components held in the structure and stores them at fixed offsets. If the third dot product is non-negative, it inverts the first two results and shifts them.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:28EA6
name: compute_global_vector_dot
description: Computes a dot product between a local vector in the structure and a global vector at a fixed offset from the frame register, then stores the scaled result in the structure.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:28ED0
name: compute_conditional_vector_dots
description: Compares a type byte with the input structure's type byte. For matching objects it stores a halved component and, when a count is non-zero, halved components of two other vectors; otherwise it computes dot products with the input vector.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:28EE2
name: compute_dot_products_or_halves
description: When a flag byte is clear it computes one or two dot products with the input vector and stores them. When the flag is set it stores halved components instead.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:28F0E
name: compute_dot_products_second_vector
description: Computes a dot product with the input vector and, when a count is non-zero, two further dot products, storing the results at fixed offsets in the structure.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:28F88
name: scale_pair_to_range_fixed
description: Takes the sign-normalized magnitudes of two values, shifts both right until the larger fits below a fixed range limit, and returns the scaled pair packed together.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:28F98
name: scale_pair_by_shift_count
description: Takes sign-normalized values and shifts two inputs right by a computed count so the magnitudes fit below a fixed range, returning the scaled pair packed together.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:28FEC
name: shift_by_logarithm
description: Counts the right shifts needed to bring a value below 16384, then shifts two input values right by that count and returns them packed.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:29010
name: invoke_two_handlers
description: Calls one routine twice in succession and then returns.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:29024
name: compute_flagged_vector_product
description: Calls helpers to obtain vector data. When one object's flag is set and another's is clear it returns two scaled dot products, otherwise it computes and returns a pair of products normalized by shifting.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:290A0
name: apply_rotation_offset
description: Obtains a 32-bit value from a helper and adds two 16-bit fields from a structure, each scaled by a shift left then right, to its halves. It returns the two halves as one 64-bit value.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:290F0
name: compute_relative_offset_pair
description: When a type byte in one structure differs from another's and matches a third, it returns a helper's pair minus two stored fields. Otherwise it returns the negated stored pair.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:29110
name: negate_pair_of_ints
description: Reads two integer fields from the structure, negates them, and returns them as one 64-bit value.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:2911E
name: compute_pair_delta_via_callback
description: Returns the stored pair unless a type byte equals one. In that case, when a flag bit is clear, it calls a callback through a vector table and returns the change in its two outputs divided by 1024; otherwise it returns zero.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:29136
name: compute_callback_pair_delta
description: When a flag bit is clear, calls a callback through a vector table with six values and returns the change in its two outputs divided by 1024. Otherwise it returns zero.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:291AC
name: normalize_and_update_motion_vector
description: Shifts a set of components so their magnitudes fit a fixed range, stores scaled values in the structure, and when a timing counter passes a limit it adjusts stored vectors through helper calls.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:291E2
name: normalize_motion_components_direct
description: Shifts three input components so their magnitudes fit a fixed range and stores them in the structure. When a timing counter passes a limit it adjusts stored vectors through helper calls.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:2928E
name: reset_motion_state_fields
description: Normalizes components by dividing them by a helper value. When a timing condition holds it zeroes the stored motion fields and returns zero.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:29306
name: scale_motion_vector_by_divisor
description: Normalizes components by shifting, scales them by dividing by a helper value, and when a threshold is passed it zeroes the stored motion fields.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:2933C
name: accumulate_scaled_motion_components
description: Normalizes three input components by shifting, adds scaled helper vector components to them, and stores the results as motion values in the structure.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:293F6
name: add_shifted_offsets_to_position
description: Adds right-shifted offsets to three input components, scales them left by a clamped count, and stores them as three longwords in the structure. It returns a helper result shifted by the same count.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:29442
name: shift_and_combine_words
description: Right shifts two input words by a variable amount and combines them into a single 64-bit result.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:2944E
name: record_undecompiled_routine_2
description: Pseudo-code could not be produced for this 2-instruction routine. The recovered evidence is that one routine calls it and it calls one other routine, so its behaviour is not recovered.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:29458
name: accumulate_correction_and_reset
description: When a stored velocity-like word is non-zero, adds a helper's returned pair into three accumulators and zeroes the motion fields, returning zero. Otherwise it scales components by shifting and returns a shifted helper result.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:29486
name: reset_entity_motion_state
description: Copies a flag byte from the second structure into the first when a flag is set, calls a helper, and adds its returned value to three 32-bit accumulators in the first structure. It then zeroes the motion fields.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:29504
name: compute_negated_projection_offsets
description: Computes three products of input components with a helper vector, subtracts the stored position words from their negated values, stores the results, and returns a shifted helper result.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:29568
name: compute_projection_offsets_signed
description: Computes three products of absolute input components with a helper vector, applies the original signs, subtracts the stored position words, stores the results, and returns a shifted helper result.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:295F8
name: scale_inputs_and_project_pair
description: Shifts three input components right until the largest magnitude fits below a fixed limit, then computes two dot products of the scaled inputs with matrix rows.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:29640
name: multiply_vector_by_matrix
description: Computes two output values by performing dot-product multiplications of three input words with rows from a matrix table, followed by a fixed right shift.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:29694
name: clamp_values_and_store
description: Clamps three input values between limits read from the structure and stores the results as three words in the structure.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:296A6
name: clamp_pair_and_store
description: Clamps two input values to limits read from the structure, raises the first input to a minimum, and stores the three results as words in the structure.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:296B0
name: clamp_pair_and_store_words
description: Clamps two input values to limits read from the structure, then stores the three results as words in the structure.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:296C2
name: clamp_pair_with_floor_store
description: Raises the first input to a floor value, clamps the second input to limits from the structure, and stores the results as words.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:296CC
name: clamp_last_value_and_store
description: Clamps the third input to limits from the structure and stores the first two inputs and the clamped value as words.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:296DE
name: raise_value_to_floor_store
description: Raises the third input to a floor value and stores the first two inputs and the result as words.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:296E8
name: store_three_words_direct
description: Stores the three input values as words in the structure without modification.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:296F0
name: accumulate_scaled_matrix_product
description: Normalizes a shift count from the input, multiplies three matrix-transformed components by weights stored in the structure, and adds the scaled products to three accumulators. When the count is negative it adds the low words into separate fields instead.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:297C2
name: accumulate_clamped_matrix_product
description: Works like the accumulator routine for matrix products, but clamps each product against stored limits and rejects the update when the addition would overflow.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:2989C
name: add_values_with_overflow_check
description: Adds input words to a stored word and to three stored longwords, and skips the update when the clamped addition would overflow.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:298B6
name: add_pair_with_overflow_check
description: Adds input values to stored words and longwords, stopping early when a signed overflow check fails.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:298D0
name: clamp_and_add_value
description: Clamps an input value to a minimum threshold, adds another value to it, and stores the result along with two other values in the structure.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:298E2
name: add_clamped_triplet_checked
description: Clamps three input values against limits stored in the structure, then adds them to three stored longwords unless a signed overflow would occur.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:298F8
name: add_bounded_triplet_checked
description: Bounds three inputs by floor and ceiling values and adds them to three stored longwords, skipping the update when a signed overflow would occur.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:29904
name: add_partial_triplet_checked
description: Clamps two inputs against limits and adds the third input directly, updating three stored longwords only when no signed overflow would occur.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:29910
name: add_bounded_pair_checked
description: Bounds two inputs against limits and adds them to stored longwords together with a third input, skipping the update on signed overflow.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:2991C
name: add_partial_pair_checked
description: Clamps one input against a limit and adds two inputs directly to stored longwords, updating only when no signed overflow would occur.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:29928
name: add_bounded_pair_checked_alt
description: Bounds one input against a limit and adds two inputs to stored longwords, updating only when no signed overflow would occur.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:29934
name: add_direct_triplet_checked
description: Adds three input values to three stored longwords, updating only when no signed overflow would occur.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:29950
name: accumulate_normalized_projection
description: When a flag byte is set, normalizes three accumulator longwords by shifting, computes a scale factor from a helper vector, and adds the scaled components into stored word and longword fields.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:299B6
name: accumulate_scaled_projection_input
description: Shifts three input values by a normalized count, multiplies them by a factor from a helper vector, and adds the products to stored word and longword fields.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:29A62
name: accumulate_shifted_scaled_triplet
description: Scales three input components by a factor from stored data, shifts them by a computed count, and adds the results to stored word and longword fields.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:29ABE
name: shift_and_accumulate
description: Conditionally right-shifts three input values when a counter passes a threshold, then adds them to three stored longwords in the structure.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:29ADE
name: add_entity_motion_records
description: Copies a flag byte between structures, adds two three-longword motion records with carry handling, then calls a helper and adds its returned pair into stored longwords.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:29B20
name: subtract_entity_position
description: Copies a flag byte into the structure, subtracts one record's position longwords from another's with borrow handling, then calls a helper and subtracts its pair from stored longwords.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:29B70
name: select_best_table_entry
description: Scans a table backward for entries with a flag bit set, compares a computed value against the best so far, and applies the chosen entry's field updates to the structure.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:29B78
name: select_best_entry_with_update
description: Returns early when a flag byte is set. Otherwise it scans table entries for the best match by a computed value, then updates the stored position fields and calls helpers.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:29C02
name: scan_entries_for_match
description: Scans table entries from the top, skipping those without a flag bit. It updates the structure when a matching key and a smaller computed value are found.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:29C34
name: accumulate_record_pair_fields
description: Copies a flag byte, adds a three-longword input record into the structure's longwords, then adds a helper's returned pair into stored longwords.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:29C3A
name: accumulate_record_pair_with_call
description: Copies a flag byte, calls a helper, adds an input record into the structure's longwords, then adds a second helper's returned pair.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:29C48
name: clear_flag_and_scan_table
description: Clears a bit in a global status byte. If that bit was set, it scans a table backward and, for entries with a second bit set, clears their fields and calls another routine.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:29C7A
name: pass_record_words_to_helper
description: Reads four words from the input record, choosing one of two field sets by a flag byte, and passes them to a helper routine.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:29C92
name: copy_matrix_to_buffer
description: Copies eight words from a source structure into a destination buffer, then zeroes two longword fields and sets two constant fields to 512 and 176. It calls one helper before and one after.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:29CCC
name: transform_object_matrix
description: Updates a cached 3x3 matrix for an object by multiplying stored basis data with a source matrix, writes the transformed basis vectors into a global structure, and returns a shifted value.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:29DB2
name: compute_relative_position_scaled
description: Subtracts stored position longwords from input values with borrow handling, shifts the differences until they fit a fixed range, and loads four longwords from a table selected by a flag field into the structure.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:29DBA
name: compute_relative_position_linked
description: Follows linked entity records until one has a flag bit set, subtracts stored position longwords with borrow handling, shifts the differences into range, and loads four longwords from a table selected by a flag field.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:29E5A
name: load_table_into_buffer
description: Copies register values into the buffer, computes a table index from a byte field, and loads four longword values from a global table into the buffer.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:29EFA
name: process_flagged_table_entries
description: Sets a status bit, then scans table entries backward for those with a flag bit set. For each one it calls helpers and updates the entity record's timers and state, writing a sentinel value when the entity matches.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:29FE8
name: process_flagged_entries_loop
description: Scans table entries backward for a flag bit. For each set entry it calls helpers, updates the entity's state and timer fields, and writes a sentinel value when the state matches.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:2A00E
name: process_flagged_entries_tail
description: Scans table entries backward for a flag bit and, for each set entry, sets a sentinel value or calls helpers depending on the entity's state fields.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:2A018
name: decrement_flagged_entry_counters
description: Scans table entries backward for a flag bit. For each set entry it calls a helper, then decrements a counter byte in the structure when it is non-zero or stores a word otherwise.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:2A046
name: process_object_flags
description: Stores a word from a parameter into a global variable, then scans a byte table backward for entries with a flag bit set. It calls a helper for each one and stops at an entry whose counter byte is clear.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:2A062
name: advance_entity_position_by_matrix
description: Looks up a frame table entry for the entity, selects one of two vector sets depending on a flag, and computes three products with the entity's matrix. It adds the products shifted right by 12 to the 64-bit position fields and sets a timer to 190.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:2A09A
name: advance_position_from_frame_table
description: Selects a vector set from a frame table by a flag, multiplies it by the entity's matrix, and adds the shifted products to the 64-bit position fields. It then sets a timer to 190.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:2A14C
name: advance_position_with_frame_calls
description: Clears a flag bit, selects a vector set from a frame table, calls two helpers to transform it, and adds the shifted products to the entity's position fields with a timer reset to 190.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:2A1C4
name: clear_status_byte_at_offset
description: Clears one status byte in the structure.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:2A1CA
name: clear_counter_and_scan_flags
description: Clears a counter word, then scans a byte table backward. For entries with bit five clear it calls two helper routines.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:2A1D2
name: iterate_and_call_handler
description: Iterates backward through a byte array. For each byte where bit 5 is clear, it calls an unnamed routine and then executes a function pointer held in a register.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:2A1F6
name: check_bounds_and_call
description: Iterates backward through a byte array, skipping bytes where bit 3 is set. For bytes where bit 5 is clear, it checks two short values against limits and calls a function pointer when both lie within bounds.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:2A236
name: decrement_counter_and_dispatch
description: Iterates backward through a byte array, processing bytes where bit 0 is set. It decrements a counter byte and, when the counter reaches zero, restores it and calls a function pointer indexed by a byte value.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:2A286
name: process_bit_two_flag
description: Clears a bit in a global variable and iterates backward through a byte array. For bytes where bit 1 is set, it calls an unnamed routine and then calls a function pointer indexed by a byte value when that value is non-zero.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:2A2C8
name: write_byte_to_indirect
description: Calculates an address from a global pointer and an offset taken from a local byte field, then writes a byte value to that address.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:2A2DC
name: store_record_in_flagged_slot
description: Searches a byte table backward for an entry with bit five set, stores the input byte there, and copies a large entity record from the input into the slot. When a second value is non-zero it also stores timing values and derived fractional fields.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:2A2FC
name: store_record_in_clear_slot
description: Searches a byte table backward for an entry with bit five clear, stores the input byte there, and copies a large entity record from the input into the slot.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:2A324
name: store_record_at_index
description: Stores the input byte at the table index given by a second input, copies a large entity record into the slot, and computes derived fields when the index is non-zero.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:2A330
name: copy_entity_record_derived
description: Copies a large entity record from one structure to another. When a second value is non-zero it computes fractional fields from table values and sets several status fields.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:2A4F2
name: store_record_in_empty_slot
description: Searches a byte table backward for an empty entry, or else for one with bit five clear. It stores the input byte, copies an entity record into the slot, and computes derived timing fields when the second value is non-zero.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:2A512
name: store_record_in_bit5_slot
description: Searches a byte table backward for an entry with bit five set and a non-zero index, stores the input byte there, copies an entity record into the slot, and computes derived fields when the second value is non-zero.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:2A548
